nom: Clinique Clarifying Face Lotion Toner 4 - For Oily Skin

segments.oily: Most reviewers describe oily or very oily skin and report reduced shine, less grease, and mattified makeup wear throughout the day, though several with extremely oily skin say the full-strength #4 burned and had to step down to #3 first.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers use it mainly on the oily T-zone, reporting good oil control there but mild dryness or excess oil removal when applied to the whole face.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers report generally tolerating the product with only occasional mild stinging or redness, though some found it too harsh, burning, and stripping.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s-60s report long-term daily use, continued exfoliation benefits, and occasional breakouts still managed with the product, with no added irritation despite age.

concerns.aging: One long-term mature-skin user reports the product still helps with occasional breakouts and keeps her complexion looking younger, though this is not a widely discussed concern.
concerns.dehydration: Several report the toner does not dry out skin and even helps with hydration or softness after use, but multiple others describe it as stripping, drying, and leaving skin feeling like a 'desert' or lacking moisture.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers report no redness or irritation, but a minority describe burning, stinging, or visible redness, especially at first use or with sensitive/very oily skin before adjusting frequency.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers warn the alcohol content can compromise the skin barrier if overused, recommending gradual introduction (every few days) to avoid burns or damage; others report no barrier issues at all with regular use.
concerns.spots: Many reviewers report visible reduction in blemishes, whiteheads, and cystic acne with continued use, though one reviewer reports large, painful new breakouts on the face and neck after starting the product.
concerns.blemishes: Numerous reviewers report clearer skin, fewer breakouts, and faster healing of individual pimples with spot treatment, while a couple report new or worsened breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: The large majority of reviewers report a clear and immediate reduction in oil and shine, describing the product as effective at removing excess oil throughout the day without needing frequent touch-ups.

aspects.libelle: Leaves skin feeling clean and refreshed
Good value for a long-term staple
Requires gradual introduction to avoid irritation
Pairs well with rest of 3-step system

extraits.texte: I wanted to love this product since I have very oily skin. When applied it burns my skin and leaves it red and feels as if it has sucked all the moisture out. My skin no doubt felt clean but not healthy. I believe it it the high alcohol content that my skin did not love unfortunately.

My skin was extremely oily, so every Clinique calculator that I tried told me that this was the clarifying lotion that I had to use. I tried it, but it burned. I had to go to #3 (which is for combination/oily skin). The Clinique sales person told me that if anyone has extremely oily skin that they should use #3 to get used to it before moving up to #4. This worked well at removing makeup and oil, though.

extraits.titre: Love this great for oily skin
extraits.texte: I have sensitive oily acne prone skin. I have been suffering from Tony white heads all over my mouth and twine area. I was using the ordinary toner and when it became sold out i figured let me just try a Clinique one since i used there moisturizer. I'm so happy i tired it . My skin has been less oily throughout the day and my white heads are gone . Have been using for little over a week. I have tried the toner that comes with acne Clinique kit and that didn't work as well for me. So Iwould say if your struggling with white heads try this !

I have sensitive oily skin that breaks out occasionally and this exfoliating lotion works wonderfully. It doesn't irritate my skin or break me out. I tried number 3 but it wasn't strong enough for my t zone. The Acne Solutions exfoliating lotion was too strong. Highly recommend this!

Ladies & gentlemen...this had ACID in it...a stronger dose of it too...so PLEASE don't just jump in head 1st with this! Take it SLOW, use once every 3 days, after 2 weeks or so, try using once every other day, and go back to every 2 days if need be, figure out what works for YOUR SKIN! Take it slow, or you could cause more damage and chemical burns(the redness & burning and itching some are speaking of). It works, but only works as much as you allow it. Again...SLOWLY, work your way up, some may only ever to use this twice a week and rotate with a gentle toner. GOOD LUCK!

extraits.titre: Amazing product, highly recommend. my favorite!
extraits.texte: absolutely wonderful product! I have very sensitive skin and it only occasionally has a mild or minimal redness or sting with it. it does have a heavy alcohol scent but when you see how well this product works none of that will matter to you. not only does it help my EXTREMELY oily skin stay plump but oil free throughout most of the day, it also will help take off any grime or dirt you didn't wash off your face before. I'm going ro be buying this for the foreseeable future. it is my favorite and the best working skin care product I have.

I bought this toner almost a year ago. I've purchased some drug store toners and they can be harsh. So my expectations weren't too high for this one. My skin is oily and sometimes sensitive so they can dry me out. But this one wasn't too harsh on my skin. I do see a difference when I use it, my skin appears to be smoother and doesn't turn my face into a desert.
